test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

Although my friends begged me, **__I chose not to go for the reunion__**.

options.text: I choose no to go for the reunion.
I have chose not to go for the reunion.
I chose not to go to the reunion.

solution:
The correct answer is **"I chose not to go to the reunion."**
